name: Zom-B-Fied!!! [UPDATE]
desc:
IMPORTANT: this is a SOLO project in it's ALPHA state, expect many bugs!! If any are found, it would be much appreciated if you report them in our Community Server or Group!

Defeat countless zombies of different types with a team of players! Unlock new guns as you progress through the rounds and explore various maps the game has to offer!!!

CONTROLS: SHIFT - sprint / CTRL - swap / Q - kick / E - interact / C - slide & crouch / R - reload / LMB - shoot / RMB - aim
